# The API generated code may call (TestContract, docs/design/library.md).
#
# public: documented API a person writes by hand. Generated code calls
# nothing else: what it would need and a person couldn't call is a gap in
# the public API, filled there (library.md, "No hidden runtime").
# stepN: an internal form generated code still calls, until step N of the
# Plan gives it a public replacement; none is left. An entry no golden uses
# fails the test.

# Kept from step 3, made public: what has no schema method to go in.
# RegisterFields is the field attributes of a struct embedding neither
# orm.Base nor ui.Live (read back with FieldAttrsOf). StaticOf, Static and
# Statics are a static of a generic type, one value per instantiation,
# which a package-level variable can't be.
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.RegisterFields
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.Static
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.StaticOf
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.Statics

# A field reference on a struct with no generated typed fields
# (Stats.Author of a plain struct) is the field by address, a kind of
# reference per field type. Call decorators are vuka.Wrap, reflective; the
# package's vuka_calls_gen.go registers a typed adapter per signature, a
# speed-up the main file doesn't depend on.
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.CompareRefTo
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.NullableRefTo
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.OrderedRefTo
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.RefTo
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.StringRefTo
